ORDER OF ADJOURNMENT

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY COUNCIL
  Regular Meeting
  April 14, 2025
  6:00 p.m.

ROLL CALL

The Alhambra City Council met in the Council Chambers of the Alhambra City Hall commencing at 6:06 p.m.
on MONDAY, April 14, 2025. Council Members present: MALONEY, MAZA, ANDRADE-STADLER, WANG,
LEE. Council Members absent: NONE. City Officials present: City Manager Binnquist, City Attorney Montes,
City Clerk Myles, Assistant City Manager Garcia, Deputy City Manager Hembree, Director of Finance Lieu,
Chief of Police Kennedy, Director of Parks & Recreation Macias, Director of Public Works and Utilities Ahlen,
Fire Chief Ragusa, Library Director LohGuan, Director of Human Resources and Risk Management Ko,
Director of Community Development Ho, Management Analyst Alvarez

ADJOURN TO 4-28-25 at 5:00 p.m. – N2M25-46

At 11:50 p.m., there being no further business for the Council to transact, with the unanimous consent of the
City Council, the Mayor:

1)  ADJOURNED this evening’s meeting to 5:00 p.m., on Monday, April 28, 2025, in the Council
  Chambers of the Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street, Alhambra, California.

  LAUREN MYLES, CMC
  CITY CLERK

Dated: April 15, 2025
Notice No. N2M25-46
